messages.author: 5307bb051713b66d
messages.subject: Plotting information curves for DIF analysis
parts:
Hello,

I conducted a DIF analysis using the mirt package and then plotted each item's information curves with the function itemplot(). All the items plotted fine except for two of them, which only showed the information curve for one of the groups whereas the rest of the plots showed both groups. I can't figure out why this would happen. Just wondering if anyone else has encountered this problem and if so how to resolve it please?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Plotting information curves for DIF analysis
parts:
Are you sure there was only one curve plotted, or were these curves overlapping each other perfectly (this will happen when using anchor items, for instance). 

Phil
